blocks.text: Performance metrics (model ka kaam naapne ke tareeqe) batate hain ke model kitna achha kaam kar raha hai. Kuch aam metrics:

Error metrics naapte hain ke model ke andaze asal qeematon se kitne alag hain. Grocery ki misal mein agar model mahine ke bill ka andaza 8,000 rupay lagaye aur asal bill 10,000 rupay ho to yeh farq (2,000 rupay) error hai.
Accuracy metrics batate hain ke model ke kitne andaze sahi the. Maslan agar model batata hai ke student pass hoga ya fail, to accuracy naapti hai ke model kitni baar sahi tha.
Yeh program pehle grocery bill ka error nikalta hai, phir pass/fail andazon ki accuracy. predicted_bill, actual_bill ya predictions aur actual ki lists badal kar Run karein.

predicted_bill = 8000
actual_bill = 10000
predictions = ["pass", "pass", "fail", "pass", "fail"]  # what the model said
actual = ["pass", "fail", "fail", "pass", "fail"]       # what really happened

error = actual_bill - predicted_bill
print("Error metric: bill error =", error, "rupees")

correct = len([p for p, a in zip(predictions, actual) if p == a])  # matching answers
accuracy = correct / len(actual) * 100
print("Accuracy metric:", correct, "out of", len(actual), "correct =", round(accuracy, 1), "%")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"predicted_bill = 8000" aur "actual_bill = 10000": grocery bill ka andaza aur asal bill.
"predictions" aur "actual": paanch students ke liye model ka pass/fail andaza aur asal nateeja.
"error = actual_bill - predicted_bill": 10000 - 8000 = 2000 rupees; yeh error metric (ghalti ka naap) hai. Yahan asal minus andaza liya gaya hai, is liye jawab musbat (positive) hai.
"zip(predictions, actual)": dono lists ke items jor jor kar deta hai; "if p == a" sirf woh jore rakhta hai jahan andaza sahi tha.
"correct = len([...])": sahi andazon ki ginti = 4 (sirf doosra andaza ghalat hai).
"accuracy = correct / len(actual) * 100": 4 / 5 x 100 = 80.0 feesad (percent).
Output: "Error metric: bill error = 2000 rupees" aur "Accuracy metric: 4 out of 5 correct = 80.0 %".
Khud try karein: actual list mein doosra "fail" badal kar "pass" kar dein: ab paanchon andaze sahi honge aur "5 out of 5 correct = 100.0 %" aayega.

blocks.prompt: Ek pass/fail model 20 andaze lagata hai aur un mein se 17 sahi hain. Accuracy kya hai?

items: Error metrics asal qeemat se farq naapte hain; accuracy metrics ginte hain ke kitne andaze sahi the.
